notes.title: Ungaland Demo Coming Soon
notes.notes: [p]🏹 We just wanted to share that We’re excited to announce that the [b]Ungaland! demo[/b] will be available to the public on Steam [b][i]very soon[/i][/b]! This will be your first chance to experience the mix of Souls-like combat and fast-paced platforming for yourself. 🌋🌋[/p]

notes.title: Ungaland! Playtest Annusment
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve released a new update for the [b]UngaLand[/b] playtest with some fixes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the boss could still damage you while frozen.[/p][/*][*][p]Pausing is now disabled during loading screens.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Amber Recovered” screen now displays correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing and helping us improve [b]UngaLand[/b] your feedback means a lot to us![/p][h3]
⚠️ [b]Just a reminder: the playtest ends tomorrow, July 4[/b], so if you haven’t tried it yet, now’s your chance!

And this is just the beginning! stay tuned for future updates and the upcoming [b]public demo[/b], where you'll get to experience even more of [b]Oogie[/b] and his wild adventures![/h3][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ungaland/ungaland"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ungaland/ungaland[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583220/b3bc6ddbd07bf047e497325375de5446673960bb.jpg"][/img][/p]
